function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station

function.name: search_trains

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: book_ticket

function.name: get_booking_status

function.name: get_cancellation_refund

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status

function.name: get_concession_fare

function.name: change_boarding_point

function.name: search_trains

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

If essential information is missing or ambiguous, ask the user instead of guessing.
Only call a tool that books, cancels, waitlists, changes, orders, files or registers something when the user asked for that action.
Follow the user's constraints exactly. If a condition fails, do not substitute a different action unless the user explicitly allowed that fallback.
Final answer format (required):
First reply to the user in natural language, in the same language as the user's request.
Then end your reply with exactly one machine-readable block, with the tags on their own lines:
<FINAL_ANSWER_JSON>
{"status": "success | cannot_complete | needs_clarification",
 "selected_train": "<train id>" or ["<train id>", ...] or null,
 "selected_class": "3A | 2A | SL | CC" or null,
 "booking_ids": ["<booking id returned by book_ticket>", ...],
 "requested_passengers": ["<passenger name as given by the user>", ...],
 "notes": "<one short sentence>",
 "answer_values": {<only the keys below that the user asked about>}}
</FINAL_ANSWER_JSON>
Rules for the block:
- status: "success" if you completed what the user asked (including a fallback the user explicitly allowed);
  "cannot_complete" if it cannot be done (invalid request, nothing satisfies the constraints, sold out with no allowed fallback, unsupported action);
  "needs_clarification" if you must ask the user before acting.
- selected_train: the train you recommend, report on, or booked; a list in travel order if the answer is several trains; null if none.
- selected_class: the travel class you recommend or booked; null if none.
- booking_ids: exactly the booking ids returned by successful book_ticket or book_tatkal_ticket calls in this conversation; [] if you booked nothing.
  Waitlist entries and cancellations are not bookings: never put their ids or PNRs in booking_ids.
- requested_passengers: the passenger names given in the request ([] if none).
- answer_values: include ONLY the keys the user's question asks about, with values copied from tool results; values
  describe selected_train when one is selected. Keys: "operating_days" (list of weekdays the train departs, e.g. ["TUE"]),
  "runs_on_requested_day" (true/false), "classes" (list of classes, e.g. ["2A", "3A"]), "station_code",
  "station_name" (full official name), "duration_minutes" (journey time in minutes, integer),
  "seats_available" (integer: seats left on the train and class the user asked about),
  "seats_remaining_at_end" (integer: seats left in the booked class after all your bookings),
  "train_count" (integer: how many trains run on the requested route and day),
  "booking_status" ("CONFIRMED", "WAITLISTED" or "CANCELLED": the status of the booking the user asked about, after your actions),
  "waitlist_position" (integer), "refund_inr" (integer: refund for a cancellation, quoted or done; the sum if several),
  "delay_minutes" (integer: how late the train is running now), "expected_arrival" (HH:MM, 24-hour: expected arrival at the
  station the user asked about), "concession_fare_inr" (integer: one concession ticket),
  "total_fare_inr" (integer: total the user asked for), "tatkal_status" ("OPEN", "NOT_YET_OPEN" or "DEPARTED"),
  "tatkal_seats" (integer), "tatkal_fare_inr" (integer), "opens_at" (HH:MM, when Tatkal booking opens), "lower_berths" (integer),
  "platform" (integer), "boarding_time" (HH:MM), "order_amount_inr" (integer: total of a meal order),
  "delivery_time" (HH:MM), "upper_berths" (integer), "side_lower_berths" (integer), "coach_position" (integer: position from the

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: resolve_station
function.description: Resolve a station or city name (any language/spelling) to canonical station code(s). Returns all matching stations; more than one candidate means the name is ambiguous.

function.name: search_trains
function.description: Search trains running from a source station to a destination station on a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Stations must be canonical station codes. Optional time_window {start, end} in 24-hour HH:MM filters by departure time at the source.

function.name: get_train_details
function.description: Get details of a train: name, type, operating days, classes, and stops with times.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check seat availability of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: get_fare
function.description: Get the fare in INR of a train for a travel class (3A, 2A, SL or CC).

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book one ticket for a passenger on a train in a travel class. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_booking_status
function.description: Look up an existing booking by its 10-digit PNR: train, class, passenger, journey date, fare, and status (CONFIRMED, WAITLISTED or CANCELLED, with the waitlist position if waitlisted).

function.name: get_cancellation_refund
function.description: Quote the cancellation charge and refund in INR for a booking (10-digit PNR) WITHOUT cancelling it. Does not change anything.

function.name: cancel_ticket
function.description: Cancel a booking by its 10-digit PNR and refund the fare minus the cancellation charge. Changes booking state. A train that has already left its origin cannot be cancelled.

function.name: join_waitlist
function.description: Put a passenger on the waitlist of a train for a travel class whose seats are sold out. Only possible when no seats are available. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_live_train_status
function.description: Get today's running status of a train (as of now): whether it is running, its delay in minutes, the last station it left, and expected arrival/departure times at each stop.

function.name: get_concession_fare
function.description: Get the discounted fare in INR of a train for a travel class for a concession (senior_citizen or student), together with the normal fare and the discount percent.

function.name: check_tatkal_availability
function.description: Check the Tatkal (urgent-travel) quota of a train for a travel class on a date (the day the train leaves its origin, YYYY-MM-DD): whether Tatkal booking is OPEN, NOT_YET_OPEN or the train has DEPARTED, when it opens, seats left and the Tatkal fare.

function.name: book_tatkal_ticket
function.description: Book one Tatkal-quota ticket (higher fare, no concessions) for a passenger on a train, class and date. Only while Tatkal booking is open for that date. Changes booking state.

function.name: get_berth_availability
function.description: Get the free berths of a train in a sleeper class (SL, 3A or 2A) by type: lower, middle, upper, side lower, side upper.

function.name: get_platform_info
function.description: Get the platform number of a train at one of its stations (canonical station code) and the order of its coaches from the engine.

function.name: change_boarding_point
function.description: Change the boarding station of a confirmed booking (10-digit PNR) to a later stop of the same train. Allowed until 24 hours before the train leaves its origin. Changes booking state.

function.name: order_meal
function.description: Order a meal (veg_thali, nonveg_thali, jain_thali or breakfast; quantity 1-6) for a confirmed booking (PNR), delivered to the seat at a station on the way. Must be ordered at least 2 hours before the train reaches that station. Changes state.

function.name: file_tdr
function.description: File a TDR (refund claim) for a confirmed booking (PNR) whose train is running at least 3 hours late; it must be filed before the train actually leaves the boarding station. Refunds the full fare. Changes state.

function.name: raise_complaint
function.description: Register a complaint (category: cleanliness, ac_not_working, water_shortage, catering, security, punctuality or other, plus an optional short description) for a booking (PNR) whose train journey is in progress now. Changes state.

function.name: get_fare
